theorem lg_target (p : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) : p * (1 - p) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
  have h2 : 0 ≤ 1 - p := sub_nonneg (le_refl 1) (le_trans h1 (le_refl 1))
  calc
    p * (1 - p) ≤ (p + (1 - p)) ^ 2 / 4
    by {
      apply Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow,
      exact le_refl p,
      exact h2,
      exact le_refl 2,
      exact le_of_lt (lt_of_le_not_ge (le_refl 1) (le_refl 1))
    }
    ... = 1 / 4
    by rw [add_right_inj, add_self_eq_twice]
